thread:
maya.engineer: heads up — seeing a p95 jump in the canary after the v12.3 runtime swap. cohort 'C' (long-inference inputs) p95 +40%, p99 ~2x. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/runtime-latency?var=cohortC :eyes:
samir.sre: how big of a sample? is it across all regions or a specific AZ?
maya.engineer: ~3k reqs sampled over last 15m, mostly us-west-2a. tail is concentrated on nodes with the new kernel-selector (commit d9f2c3).
tara.support: we have two customers in cohort C reporting slow responses (support ticket #4621). I flagged them. Any quick mitigation before they escalate?
leo.runtime: hypothesis: the kernel-selector change bumped slow-path by forcing serialized batch scheduling for certain seq-lengths. saw something similar in staging last week. commit link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/commit/d9f2c3
maya.engineer: stacktrace/snippet from runtime logs (canary node):
```
[2026-02-12T14:02:11.345Z] INFO request_id=abc123 queue_time_ms=12 exec_time_ms=240 kernel=latebinding scheduler=serialized-batch
[2026-02-12T14:02:11.346Z] INFO request_id=def456 queue_time_ms=10 exec_time_ms=25 kernel=fastpath scheduler=parallel-batch
```
shows a bimodal exec_time pattern.
samir.sre: queue_time is fine, exec_time is the problem. can you repro with the long prompt locally? what input lengths?
maya.engineer: repro curl (matches customer):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd/long-13b","input":"'"'"'<~4k tokens of text>'"'"'","max_tokens":512,"temperature":0.0}'
```
I see the same slow tail when routed to v12.3 variant.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary-p95-threshold-breached for runtime:v12.3 cohort:C — triggered at 2026-02-12T14:05:00Z.
leo.runtime: quick mitigation options: 1) pause rollout 2) route cohort C back to v12.2 3) apply runtime feature-flag to disable new kernel-selector on canary nodes. which is fastest?
maya.engineer: easiest: route cohort C back to v12.2 via route-slew. I'll create the routing override.
tara.support: please notify affected customers when done. I'll draft msg: "we're aware, routing to previous runtime while we investigate."
